alternatives_detail.description: Immediate market order during regular session at first available price.
alternatives_detail.when_to_prefer: Highest liquidity, willing to accept opening volatility and spread.

alternatives_detail.description: Limit-on-open routed to exchange opening auction.
alternatives_detail.when_to_prefer: Price discovery via opening auction; avoids paying spread for first prints.

alternatives_detail.description: Limit-on-open with explicit limit offset; cancel if not filled.
alternatives_detail.when_to_prefer: Strong price protection requirement; missed fill is acceptable.

alternatives_detail.description: Wait 5 minutes after open before submitting market order.
alternatives_detail.when_to_prefer: Reduces opening-auction volatility; loses opening-momentum signal.

alternatives_detail.description: Time-weighted average over a 5-30 minute window after open.
alternatives_detail.when_to_prefer: Large orders relative to ADV; controls market impact.

recommendation_rationale: Recommended opg_limit (Limit-on-open routed to exchange opening auction.). Daily next-bar-open execution → opening-auction routing preferred.
